summary:
Held 0 of today's 10 biggest UK/EU movers.

• 6 upside misses — INF.L +6%, WTB.L +4%, WEIR.L +4%, BNP.PA +3%, INVP.L +3%. These cleared the universe screen but no strategy picked them up; the morning brief either filtered them on a catalyst/RSI/earnings rule or had nothing positive to trigger an entry.

• 4 downside moves (BA.L -4%, SU.PA -4%, HO.PA -4%, BESI.AS -4%) are unreachable on a long-only basket — no mechanism to express a short or pair-trade.

• Most instructive miss: INF.L (+5.62%) — No obvious news catalyst found for 2026-10-07. Searches only returned routine buyback RNS filings, so this is likely a technical or sector rebound in UK events/media, or a continuation of the buyback bid. Why we passed: Outside any active strategy's universe. INF.L is a FTSE 100 events and publishing name that no strategy lists. With no news trigger, a news-reactive bot had no signal, and a +5.6% move on a large-cap is below typical gap or momentum thresholds.
